posts.content: ComfyUI-RMBG: A ComfyUI custom node designed for advanced image background removal and object, face, clothes, and fashion segmentation, utilizing multiple models including RMBG-2.0, VRMBG-3.0, FeyNoBg, Finegrain Box Segmenter, INSPYRENET, BEN, BEN2, BiRefNet, Lucida, SDMatte, SAM, SAM2, SAM3, Florence-2, YOLOv8/YOLO11, Big-Lama, and GroundingDINO.

ai.title: ComfyUI-RMBG: Advanced background removal with RMBG-2.0, VRMBG-3.0, BiRefNet, SAM2, SAM3, Florence-2
ai.summary: ComfyUI custom node for background removal and object/face/clothes segmentation using multiple models. Supports RMBG-2.0, VRMBG-3.0, BiRefNet, SAM2, SAM3, Florence-2, YOLO11, and other specialized segmentation models.
ai.why_important: Provides production-ready segmentation options with multiple model backends for different use cases in a single ComfyUI node.
ai.learnings: Multiple segmentation models can be integrated into a single ComfyUI node to handle different object types and quality requirements.

posts.content: blender-ai-mcp-addon: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.

ai.title: blender-ai-mcp-addon: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender with multi-agent workflows
ai.summary: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender featuring visual chat, scene tools, and multi-agent workflows. Compatible with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode for bpy Python scripting.
ai.why_important: Multi-model AI integration for Blender enables complex 3D workflows through natural language and agent orchestration.
ai.learnings: MCP server architecture can support multiple AI models simultaneously for Blender scripting and scene manipulation.

posts.content: openmotion: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.

ai.title: openmotion: Turn reference video into editable motion graphics with brand kit, export for social
ai.summary: Open-source alternative to Claude Motion & CapCut that converts reference videos into editable motion graphics with brand kit integration. Export MP4s for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok with support for 22 AI agents.
ai.why_important: Provides open-source motion graphics workflow from reference video to platform-specific exports with brand consistency.
ai.learnings: Reference video can be transformed into editable motion graphics using agentic workflows with brand kit enforcement across social platforms.

posts.content: ComfyUI-Lora-Manager: Visual model, recipe, and workflow manager with deep ComfyUI integration: custom loader and metadata nodes, one-click workflow actions, downloads, organization, and standalone support.

ai.title: ComfyUI-Lora-Manager: Visual model, recipe, and workflow manager with deep ComfyUI integration
ai.summary: A ComfyUI extension that provides visual management for models, recipes, and workflows with custom loader and metadata nodes. Includes one-click workflow actions, downloads, organization, and standalone support.
ai.why_important: Streamlines model and workflow management in ComfyUI, reducing friction in iterative creative processes.
ai.learnings: Custom nodes can be built to integrate model management directly into ComfyUI workflows with metadata tracking.

posts.content: LichtFeld-Studio: Train, inspect, edit, automate, and export 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from a single native application.

ai.title: LichtFeld-Studio: Train, inspect, edit, automate, and export 3DGS scenes from single native app
ai.summary: Native application for training, inspecting, editing, automating, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. Single unified interface for complete 3DGS workflow.
ai.why_important: Consolidates fragmented 3DGS workflows into a single native application, eliminating pipeline friction.
ai.learnings: 3DGS workflows can be unified in a single native app covering training through export instead of juggling multiple tools.

posts.content: Toonflow-app: 短剧、漫剧制作工具 Toonflow：开源 AI 视频创作平台，集成剧本创作、智能分镜、角色与场景资产管理、图像生成和视频生成。融合无限画布、AI Agent 与可视化工作流，支持本地部署、自选模型、跨平台客户端、MCP 与插件扩展。Open-source AI short drama and motion comic creation tool with an infinite canvas, AI agents, storyboarding, image and video generation. Self-hosted and extensible, with a canvas-based approach similar to LibTV and TapNow.

ai.title: Toonflow-app: AI视频创作平台，集成剧本、分镜、资产管理、图像与视频生成
ai.summary: 开源AI视频创作平台，支持剧本创作、智能分镜、角色与场景资产管理、图像和视频生成。融合无限画布、AI Agent与可视化工作流，支持本地部署和自选模型。
ai.why_important: 提供端到端的短剧和漫剧制作流程，从剧本到视频生成，支持本地部署和模型自选。
ai.learnings: 无限画布结合AI Agent可以在单一平台内完成从剧本到视频的完整短剧制作流程。

posts.content: mcp-for-blender: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice. Not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.

ai.title: mcp-for-blender: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM
ai.summary: Community plugin enabling control of Blender 3D through any LLM using the Model Context Protocol. Allows natural language control of 3D modeling operations.
ai.why_important: Bridges LLM capabilities with Blender's Python API, enabling AI-assisted 3D workflows through natural language.
ai.learnings: MCP can be used to create LLM interfaces for complex 3D software like Blender without official API integration.
